newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt sticks to 2.3 pct 1997 growth forecast.
newsitem.headline: French govt sticks to 2.3 pct 1997 growth forecast.

text.p: The French government is sticking to its forecast of 2.3 percent growth in 1997, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said on Wednesday.
Finance Minister Jean Arthuis was due to present the government's economic outlook at 1500 GMT after a review of economic forecasts made last year in the 1997 budget.
Asked whether the government would stick to its forecast this year of 2.3 percent growth after 1.3 percent last year, Lamassoure said: "It will be 2.3 percent".
He was speaking to reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting.
